_readme: DELETE THIS '_readme' KEY before using the file -- gateway/config.py's own validator will reject it otherwise (it is not a valid API key: too short, and its value is not a valid tenant_id). Copy this file to api-keys.dev.local.json (gitignored) in the same folder, delete this key, then replace all three example keys below with real, randomly generated ones before running `make helm-apply-dev`. See helm/ai-platform/templates/gateway-secret.yaml and scripts/deploy/helm.sh's gateway_api_keys_json_for() for how this file is used. Shape: "<api key>": "<tenant_id>". tenant_id must match ai_service/schemas.py's TENANT_ID_PATTERN (lowercase letters/digits/-/_,  starting with a letter or digit, max 32 chars). Generate a real key with: python3 -c "import secrets; print('sk-' + secrets.token_urlsafe(24))". Phase 14: three tenants, not one -- 'demo' (the standard tier, no override in values-dev.yaml's GATEWAY_TENANT_LIMITS_JSON), 'acme' (premium, 2x rate/burst, 2.5x quota) and 'globex' (trial, 1/6 rate/burst, 1/10 quota) -- see docs/multitenancy.md and ADR-32.
